- The brown necrosis creates the characteristic "burned" or "scalded" appearance
- The progression from the midrib outward is exactly as described

- Not Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus (would show mosaic patterns, not pencil lines)
- Not Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv (would show multiple small streaks, not a continuous line)
- Not Yellow_Leaf (would show primarily midrib yellowing without the white pencil line)
